analyst.summary: Jubilant Pharmova has a genuinely improving operating trend - moving from a loss to steady quarterly profit over the past two years, powered partly by its strong US radiopharmaceutical business - but returns on capital remain weak (mid-single-digit ROE) and the company carries meaningful debt with a flagged practice of capitalizing some interest costs, which can flatter reported profit. A large one-off gain inflated one quarter's results and should not be read as a growth run-rate. At 34-40 times trailing earnings for this return profile, we do not see enough margin of safety to move off a Sell.
